decisions.choice: Appended ': checked in phase p1' to the single existing line instead of rewriting it.
decisions.whyItMatters: notes.txt stays an accurate, self-describing record: the original content is preserved verbatim and only a short provenance note is added, so the file still means what it did before.

alternatives.option: Rewrite the line entirely with new wording
alternatives.consequence: Any meaning a reader relied on in the original text would be lost, and the note would no longer be a safe, additive change.

alternatives.option: Add a second line to the file
alternatives.consequence: It would break the file's stated one-line shape, contradicting notes.txt's own description of itself.

recommendation.choice: Append a short provenance suffix to the one existing line
recommendation.reason: It keeps the file accurate and one-line while recording that p1 reviewed it.

assumptions: notes.txt's single line is content to preserve, not a placeholder to be replaced.
